youtube.title: Keyboard ke F aur J keys par bumps kyun hote hain? ⌨️ #Shorts
youtube.description:
Apne keyboard ko dekhiye. Sirf do keys par chhote se bumps hote hain, F aur J. Baaki saari keys smooth hain, toh in dono mein aisa kya khaas hai?

Wajah ye hai ki yahin aapki index fingers rakhi jaati hain. Fast typists keys ko dekhte nahi, bumps ko feel karte hain. Index fingers mil jayein, toh baaki fingers apni jagah par aa jaati hain. Is row ko home row kehte hain.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
